description: Defines the PatchPanel class and its nested classes for managing audio patches, ports, and software patches within Android's AudioFlinger system. Includes methods for creating, releasing, and querying audio patches and ports, as well as handling software patches and stream notifications.

classes.name: PatchPanel
classes.description: Manages audio patches, ports, and software patches within Android's AudioFlinger system.

classes.name: PatchPanel::SoftwarePatch
classes.description: Represents a software audio patch with handles to the patch and associated threads.

classes.name: PatchPanel::Endpoint
classes.description: Template class representing an endpoint for audio patch connections, managing thread and track associations.

classes.name: PatchPanel::Patch
classes.description: Represents an audio patch, including connection endpoints and methods for managing connections.

methods.name: listAudioPorts
methods.description: Lists connected audio ports and their attributes.

methods.name: getAudioPort
methods.description: Retrieves supported attributes for a given audio port.

methods.name: createAudioPatch
methods.description: Creates a patch between source and sink ports.

methods.name: releaseAudioPatch
methods.description: Releases a specified audio patch.

methods.name: listAudioPatches
methods.description: Lists connected audio patches and their attributes.

methods.name: getDownstreamSoftwarePatches
methods.description: Retrieves all established software patches for a stream on an intermediate module.

methods.name: notifyStreamOpened
methods.description: Notifies the patch panel about an opened stream.

methods.name: notifyStreamClosed
methods.description: Notifies the patch panel about a closed stream.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of the PatchPanel to a file descriptor.

methods.name: checkTrack
methods.description: Checks if a track is initialized properly.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Returns the handle of the patch endpoint.

methods.name: thread
methods.description: Returns the thread associated with the endpoint.

methods.name: track
methods.description: Returns the track associated with the endpoint.

methods.name: closeConnections
methods.description: Closes connections for the endpoint, releasing patches and threads.

methods.name: setThread
methods.description: Sets the thread for the endpoint.

methods.name: setTrackAndPeer
methods.description: Sets the track and peer proxy for the endpoint.

methods.name: clearTrackPeer
methods.description: Clears the peer proxy for the track.

methods.name: stopTrack
methods.description: Stops the track.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two endpoints.

methods.name: createConnections
methods.description: Creates connections for the patch.

methods.name: clearConnections
methods.description: Clears connections for the patch.

methods.name: isSoftware
methods.description: Checks if the patch is a software patch.

methods.name: setThread
methods.description: Associates a thread with the patch.

methods.name: thread
methods.description: Returns the thread associated with the patch.

methods.name: getLatencyMs
methods.description: Returns the latency of the patch in milliseconds.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the patch for debugging.
